scope.current_boundary: Consolidates legacy l03 and l04 into one unified lesson covering cathode-ray oscilloscope (CRO) trace measurements (y-gain, time-base, peak voltage, period, frequency), derivation of the wave equation v = f lambda from speed, frequency, and wavelength definitions, application of v = f lambda with prefix conversions, and direct synthesis of CRO frequency measurements with wave speed calculations. Internal CRO electron gun and deflection electronics, wave classifications (transverse/longitudinal), wave intensity, Doppler effects, and stationary waves are excluded.
prior_scope_summaries_consulted: 9702_t07_cm01_l01: Wave motion as energy transfer without net transfer of matter, progressive wave properties.
9702_t07_cm01_l02: Wave definitions of displacement, amplitude, period, frequency, phase difference, wavelength, and T = 1/f.
9702_t01: Physical quantities, SI base units, prefixes (kilo, mega, giga, milli, micro, nano, pico), and uniform speed kinematics (v = d/t).

immediate_previous.boundary: Wave quantities and phase: definitions of displacement, amplitude, phase difference, period, frequency, wavelength, and speed (9702_t07_m01_o02).
can_assume: Displacement, amplitude, period, frequency, wavelength definitions (Topic 7 CM01 L02)
Period and frequency reciprocal relationship T = 1/f (Topic 7 CM01 L02)
Metric prefixes and standard index form conversions (Topic 1)

immediate_next.boundary: Transverse and longitudinal waves and wave graphs: compare transverse and longitudinal waves (9702_t07_m02_o01) and analyse graphical representations of waves (9702_t07_m02_o02).
must_not_preteach: Classification of transverse and longitudinal waves
Particle vibration direction relative to wave propagation direction
Compressions and rarefactions in sound waves

definitions_considered.reason: Foundational wave quantity needed to interpret horizontal oscilloscope trace measurements.
definitions_considered.markdown_anchor: Measuring amplitude and frequency with a CRO and the wave equation > Fundamental wave properties: "The period $T$ is the time taken for one complete oscillation or wave cycle."

definitions_considered.reason: Core syllabus definition required to determine frequency from period via reciprocal relation.
definitions_considered.markdown_anchor: Measuring amplitude and frequency with a CRO and the wave equation > Fundamental wave properties: "Frequency $f$ is the number of complete oscillations or wave cycles per unit time, measured in hertz ($	ext{Hz}$)."

definitions_considered.reason: Core syllabus definition required to distinguish peak voltage from peak-to-peak voltage.
definitions_considered.markdown_anchor: Measuring amplitude and frequency with a CRO and the wave equation > Fundamental wave properties: "Amplitude is the maximum displacement of a particle or point on a wave from its equilibrium position."

definitions_considered.reason: Core spatial wave quantity needed for wave equation derivation and synthesis calculations.
definitions_considered.markdown_anchor: Measuring amplitude and frequency with a CRO and the wave equation > Fundamental wave properties: "Wavelength is the minimum distance between two adjacent points on a wave that are in phase."

formulas_considered.name: Period and frequency
formulas_considered.reason: Direct formula connecting time-base period measurements to signal frequency.
formulas_considered.markdown_anchor: Measuring amplitude and frequency with a CRO and the wave equation > Fundamental wave properties: "$$T = \frac{1}{f} \quad \text{and} \quad f = \frac{1}{T}$$"

formulas_considered.name: Wave speed
formulas_considered.reason: Core syllabus formula v = f lambda derived and applied throughout the lesson.
formulas_considered.markdown_anchor: Measuring amplitude and frequency with a CRO and the wave equation > Deriving the wave equation: "$$v = \frac{\lambda}{\frac{1}{f}} = f\lambda$$"
